Name: Community Center Fish in Mines
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[b]T[/b]his mod allows you to obtain all fish required for the Community Center directly in the mines, using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44654]IamMineFish framework.[/url]

Fish are distributed across mine zones based on progression, keeping a simple and consistent structure.

[size=4]How it works[/size]

The mod adds Community Center fish to different mine fishing zones:.

Each fish has a configured weight within the framework system, determining its chance of appearing when fishing.

[size=4]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds all Community Center fish to the mines[/*]
[*]Progression-based distribution[/*]
[*]Fully integrated with the IamMineFish weight system[/*]
[*]Compatible with other mods using the same framework[/*]
[/list][size=4]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]IamMineFish[/*]
[/list][size=4]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Install IamMineFish[/*]
[*]Copy this mod into your Mods/ folder[/*]
[/list]
